titleEn: How Much Does a Renovation Cost in Vancouver & Metro Vancouver in 2026?
titleZh: 2026年溫哥華及大溫地區裝修費用是多少？
contentEn:
If you are budgeting for a renovation in Vancouver, Richmond, Burnaby, or anywhere across Metro Vancouver in 2026, you need realistic numbers before you sign a contract. Reno Stars has completed more than 200 renovation projects across the Lower Mainland since 2015, and those real jobs form the basis of every cost range in this guide.

What Is the Average Renovation Cost Per Square Foot in Metro Vancouver?

Across our completed projects, all-in costs (materials, labour, permits, and HST) for full-scope residential renovations in Metro Vancouver range from $180 to $400 per square foot, depending on scope. A mid-range kitchen renovation in Vancouver typically runs $35,000–$75,000; a complete whole-home renovation in the $600,000–$1.4 million range reflects the complexity of structural changes, custom millwork, and current material costs in BC.

These figures come from Reno Stars' actual project cost data, not industry averages drawn from provinces with lower labour rates or different code requirements.

Metro Vancouver Renovation Cost by Room and Scope (2026)

  • Kitchen renovation (mid-range): $35,000–$75,000 — cabinets, countertops, appliances, flooring, lighting, permitting where required.
  • Bathroom renovation (mid-range): $18,000–$40,000 — tiling, fixtures, vanity, ventilation, re-lining or re-piping as needed.
  • Whole-home renovation (complete): $600,000–$1,400,000+ — structural work, all new mechanical systems, full millwork package, exterior cladding, landscaping reset.
  • Condo renovation (turnkey): $800–$200 per square foot — lower structural cost, but Strata approval timelines add 4–8 weeks.
  • Basement renovation (suite-ready): $35,000–$90,000 — framing, insulation, drywall, separate HVAC zone, separate electrical panel, bathroom rough-in.
  • Structural or additions: Engineer fees ($3,000–$12,000), permit fees (1%–2% of construction value), and BC Building Code compliance reviews are additional line items that separate renovation from new construction pricing.

What Drives Renovation Costs Higher in Vancouver Right Now?

Three factors are compressing budgets across the Lower Mainland in 2026. First, skilled trade labour is the primary cost driver: framers, electricians, and tile setters in BC command $65–$95 per hour, and scheduling three trades concurrently requires a full-time project manager. Second, materials pricing has not fully normalised post-2020: dimensional lumber, gypsum board, and specialty tiles carry 10%–25% premiums over 2019 baseline prices. Third, the City of Vancouver and Metro municipalities have increased permit fees by an average of 8% for 2026, and heritage-listed properties require a Heritage Conservation Plan before any permit is issued, adding $4,000–$16,000 to pre-construction costs.

A renovation project in Vancouver that appears 15% cheaper than market rate before contracts are signed almost always surfaces hidden conditions during demolition — asbestos in artex ceilings, out-of-spec load-bearing walls, or insufficient electrical service for a modern kitchen. Reno Stars includes a fixed-price contingency line in every contract and advises clients to hold 10%–15% in reserve for conditions uncovered during work.

How to Budget Your Vancouver Renovation in 2026

The budgeting process has four steps. Step one is a schematic estimate: multiply your target square footage by $180 (economy) to $400 (premium) and get a preliminary range. Step two is a scope document — a written list of what stays, what moves, and what is removed — signed by you and your contractor before any money changes hands. Step three is a detailed quote line-itemised by trade, not a single lump sum, so you can see where the cost sits when finish selections are made. Step four is a fixed-price contract that locks material costs for the duration of the project, with a schedule of values tied to completed milestones.

Planning a kitchen, bathroom, whole-home or commercial renovation? Get a free, no-obligation quote from Reno Stars.

Vancouver vs. Other Major Canadian Cities: How Do Costs Compare?

Vancouver renovation costs run 18%–25% higher than Toronto and 30%–35% higher than Montreal when labour, permit fees, and material logistics are factored in together. The primary gap is not material costs — those are similar across major Canadian cities — but the combination of limited trade availability, strict municipal inspection regimes, and the physical cost of transporting materials into the Lower Mainland. A Reno Stars kitchen renovation at $55,000 includes the same scope as a $42,000 kitchen in Edmonton; the premium reflects Lower Mainland market conditions, not a markup.

FAQs: Vancouver Renovation Costs in 2026

Does Reno Stars offer fixed-price contracts?

Yes. Every Reno Stars project is priced on a fixed-price schedule of values basis, with a defined contingency line for conditions discovered during work. Fixed-price means your renovation cost does not change because your contractor underestimated labour hours, provided the scope document is unchanged.

What permit costs should I budget for a Vancouver renovation?

City of Vancouver building permit fees for residential alterations run approximately 1%–2% of the declared construction value, plus $200–$500 in plan examination fees. Heritage properties add a Heritage Conservation Plan fee of $3,000–$12,000. For a $150,000 kitchen-and-bath renovation, budget $2,500–$5,000 for permits and associated professional reports.

How long does a full renovation take in Vancouver?

A mid-range kitchen renovation takes 6–10 weeks from permit issuance to practical completion. A full whole-home renovation in Vancouver typically runs 9–18 months depending on structural scope, site conditions, and municipal inspection timelines. Condo renovations are faster: 4–8 weeks for a turnkey scope, plus 4–8 weeks for Strata approval if required.

Are Reno Stars projects covered by warranty?

Yes. Reno Stars provides a two-year labour warranty on all renovation work, backed by a Contractua financial warranty for completed projects. All subcontractors carry valid BC liability insurance and WSBC coverage.

Can I live in my home during a kitchen or bathroom renovation?

Most single-room renovations can be completed with the homeowner in residence if a temporary kitchen setup is available. Full gut renovations of kitchens or bathrooms require 3–6 weeks of displaced use. Reno Stars coordinates with each homeowner to minimise disruption and provides a written scope of work that defines which spaces are accessible on which days.

想在2026年於溫哥華、列治文、本拿比或大溫其他城市規劃裝修項目，您需要在簽約前掌握真實的費用數據。聚星裝修自2015年以來已在低陸地區完成超過200個裝修項目，本文所有費用範圍均基於這些真實項目數據。

大溫地區每平方英尺的平均裝修費用是多少？

根據聚星裝修已完成項目的實際成本數據，大溫住宅全面裝修項目（含材料、人工、許可證及HST）的全包價格約為每平方英尺180至400加元，具體取決於工程範圍。溫哥華中等規模廚房裝修通常為35,000至75,000加元；全面房屋裝修因涉及結構改造、定製細木家具及當前BC省材料成本，造價在600,000至140萬加元以上。

2026年大溫地區各房型及工程範圍裝修費用

  • 廚房裝修（中等規模）：35,000至75,000加元——櫥櫃、枱面、電器、地板、照明及所需許可證。
  • 浴室裝修（中等規模）：18,000至40,000加元——瓷磚、衛生潔具、洗手盆、通風系統及管道維修。
  • 全面房屋裝修：600,000至1,400,000加元以上——結構工程、全新機電系統、定製細木工程、外牆包覆及景觀改造。
  • 公寓裝修（全套）：每平方英尺800至1,200加元——結構工程成本較低，但需額外預留4至8週Strata審批時間。
  • 地下室裝修（套房標準）：35,000至90,000加元——間隔、隔熱、石膏板、独立供暖分區、独立電箱、浴室管道預留。
  • 結構改建或擴建：工程師費用3,000至12,000加元，許可證費用為工程造價的1%至2%，另需符合BC省建築規範的合規審查費用。

什麼因素在2026年推高了溫哥華的裝修成本？

三個主要因素正在壓縮低陸地區的裝修預算。第一，技術工人的勞動力成本是主要驅動因素：BC省的框架工、電工和瓷磚工的時薪為65至95加元，三個工種同時調度需要全職項目經理統籌。第二，2020年以來的材料價格尚未完全正常化：結構木材、石膏板和特種瓷磚仍較2019年基準價格高出10%至25%。第三，溫哥華市及大溫各市鎮2026年許可證費用平均上調8%，而歷史文物建築需要先編制《文物保護計劃》才能申請任何許可證，額外增加4,000至16,000加元的前期成本。

在溫哥華，若一個裝修項目在合同簽署前的報價比市場價格低15%，幾乎無一例外會在拆除階段暴露隱藏問題——吊頂中的石棉、規格不符的承重牆或無法支撐現代厨房的電力系統。聚星裝修在每份合同中均包含固定價格的應急款項線，並建議業主預留10%至15%的儲備金，以應對施工期間發現的問題。

如何為2026年溫哥華裝修制定預算

制定預算需分四步。第一步是初步估算：將目標建築面積乘以180加元（經濟型）至400加元（高端），得出初步範圍。第二步是編制工程範圍文件——一份書面清單，列明保留項目、搬遷項目及拆除項目，並由業主和承包商簽署後方生效。第三步是詳盡的報價，按工種分項列出，而非單一總價，這樣您可以在選擇材料時看清成本所在。第四步是固定價格合同，將材料成本在整個項目期間鎖定，並與已完工節點掛鈎。

計劃進行廚房、浴室、全屋或商業裝修？立即聯絡聚星裝修，免費取得無約束力報價。

溫哥華與其他加拿大主要城市的裝修成本如何比較？

綜合人工、許可證費用及材料物流因素計算，溫哥華裝修成本較多倫多高出18%至25%，較蒙特利爾高出30%至35%。主要差距不在材料成本——加拿大各主要城市的材料價格相近——而在於技術工人供應緊張、嚴格的市政府檢驗制度及將材料運入低陸地區的實際物流成本。聚星裝修在溫哥華的55,000加元廚房裝修，與在埃德蒙頓的42,000加元廚房項目工程範圍相同；差價反映的是低陸地區市場條件，而非利潤加成。

常見問題：2026年溫哥華裝修費用

聚星裝修是否提供固定價格合同？

是的。聚星裝修每個項目均按固定價格工程進度表定價，並包含一條明確的應急款項線，用於應對施工期間發現的問題。固定價格意味著，只要工程範圍文件不變，您的裝修費用不會因承包商低估工時而增加。

溫哥華裝修需要預算多少許可證費用？

溫哥華市住宅改建建築許可證費用約為申報工程造價的1%至2%，另加200至500加元的圖紙審查費。文物建築需額外繳交《文物保護計劃》費用3,000至12,000加元。以一個150,000加元的廚房及浴室裝修為例，許可證及相關專業報告預算為2,500至5,000加元。

溫哥華全面裝修需要多長時間？

中等規模廚房裝修從許可證發出到實際完工通常需要6至10週。溫哥華全面房屋裝修因結構工程範圍、现场條件及市政府檢驗時間而異，通常需要9至18個月。公寓裝修較快：全套工程4至8週，另需預留4至8週Strata審批時間（如需要）。

聚星裝修的項目有保固嗎？

有的。聚星裝修對所有裝修工程提供兩年人工保固，並由Contractua金融保固提供支持。所有分包商均持有效BC省責任保險及WSBC保障。

裝修期間我可以繼續住在屋內嗎？

大多數單房裝修可在業主繼續入住的情況下完成，前提是設有臨時廚房配套。廚房或浴室的全面翻新通常需要3至6週的搬出期。聚星裝修與每位業主協調，尽量減少不便，並提供書面工程範圍文件，明確界定哪些區域在哪些日子可以使用。
